language.title: Language
language.description: Porchlight's own text. Music from YouTube stays as it is.

consent.title: Word-by-word lyrics from Kugou and NetEase
consent.description: Choose whether Porchlight may contact Kugou and NetEase.
consent.p1: Porchlight can get word-by-word lyrics from Kugou and NetEase, two music services based in China.
consent.p2: If you accept, for each song you play they receive its title, artist and length. Like any website, they also see your computer's IP address. They never get your name, accounts, cookies, logins or listening history.
consent.p3: You can change this any time in Settings > Lyrics.

ai.shown: AI music shown · click to hide
ai.hidden: AI music hidden · click to show
ai.accuracyTitle: AI filtering is pretty good, but not perfect.
ai.accuracyText: We detect AI music using community-run lists checked against Spotify. New or unlisted AI artists can still slip through. If you spot one, right-click the song and choose Mark artist as AI, and it'll be hidden from then on.
ai.playAnywayTitle: AI music is off. Play anyway?
ai.playAnywayText: This song is marked as AI-generated. Playing it won't change your setting.

premiumGate.checkInTitle: Connect to the internet to keep using downloads
premiumGate.checkInText: Porchlight checks your Music Premium subscription at least once every 30 days. Go online for a moment and your downloads will play again.
premiumGate.signedOutText: Porchlight plays music through your YouTube Music account. Sign in with an account that has an active Music Premium subscription.
premiumGate.noPremiumText: Your account doesn't have an active Music Premium subscription, which YouTube requires for ad-free playback.
premiumGate.adsNote1: Free YouTube Music is supported by ads. YouTube's Terms of Service require those ads to play, and Porchlight has no way to show them, so YouTube limits ad-free playback to Premium accounts.
premiumGate.adsNote2: Porchlight itself stays completely free and open source, and always will be.
premiumGate.adsNote3: You can keep listening for free, with ads, at music.youtube.com.
premiumGate.experimentalText: We don't recommend this. It has no downloads, it may stop working at any time, and YouTube could limit your account. You choose to use it, and you're responsible for that choice. Porchlight and its contributors accept no responsibility for how you use it.

report.title: Report an issue
report.description: Tell us what went wrong or what you'd like to see. Submitting opens a prefilled GitHub issue in your browser.
report.body: What happened? Steps to reproduce, expected vs actual…
report.thanks: Thanks! Finish submitting the issue in your browser.
